stories.title: No 10 Leak: Burnham branded 'continuity PM' after Starmer documents revealed
stories.summary: Sky News obtained a sensitive leaked Downing Street document showing the extent to which PM Burnham has adopted Starmer's planned but unimplemented policies, prompting opposition to brand him a continuity prime minister.

stories.title: Burnham shelves Starmer's flagship annual investment summit
stories.summary: PM Burnham has cancelled the investment event that Starmer had planned for later this year, with the next summit expected to take place outside London in line with his 're-industrialisation' agenda.

stories.title: Burnham rejects 'tax and spend socialist' label ahead of challenging budget
stories.summary: PM Burnham pushed back on characterisations of his economic approach, acknowledging the upcoming autumn budget will be difficult while the Bank of England held rates at 3.75% amid Middle East war risks.

topics.name: Burnham Gov Intelligence
topics.description: Procurement, tech/AI, spending, vendor & priority signals

stories.title: 🏗️ MoJ signs £100m BT 'bridging' deal to maintain prisoners' telephony
stories.summary: The Ministry of Justice has awarded a £100 million bridging contract to BT for prisoner telephony services while a longer-term procurement is prepared.

stories.title: 🤖 NHS signs £200m AI and digital deal to upgrade screening services
stories.summary: NHS England has signed a major £200 million AI and digital transformation contract covering cancer and disease screening services — one of the largest health tech procurements of the year.

stories.title: 💰 UK losing £1.3mn a day on nationalised steelworks amid Burnham's re-industrialisation push
stories.summary: The FT reports Britain's nationalised steelworks are costing £1.3m a day in losses, with Burnham's re-industrialisation agenda cited as the political reason the PM cannot let the operation fail.

topics.name: Parliament
topics.description: House of Commons, Lords, PMQs, debates & legislation

stories.title: Parliament returns: Burnham makes first Commons statement as PM
stories.summary: The House of Commons returned for the autumn session and Andy Burnham made his first formal statement as Prime Minister in the chamber, marking the start of a packed parliamentary schedule.

stories.title: House of Lords debates education and skills reform statement
stories.summary: The Lords heard the government's education and skills reform statement from Baroness Smith of Malvern, covering apprenticeships, skills policy and training reform.

stories.title: House of Lords debates VAT impact on independent schools
stories.summary: Peers debated the government's decision to apply VAT to private school fees, with crossbench and Conservative peers raising concerns about the effect on smaller independent schools.

stories.title: Trade unions, MPs and donors urge Burnham to revisit party funding rules
stories.summary: Significant internal Labour pressure is building on the PM to reform political donation rules, with the party movement and major donors aligned in calling for change.

stories.title: Government seeks to change law on political donations from British expats
stories.summary: The Burnham government is pursuing legislation to allow UK political parties to receive donations from British citizens living abroad — a potentially significant change to party finance law.

stories.title: Poll: 43% think Burnham is similar to Starmer; 31% see genuine change of direction
stories.summary: A new poll shows Labour voters are divided on whether Burnham represents continuity or change from the Starmer era, with opinion split as the No 10 leak story dominates the news cycle.

stories.title: Badenoch appoints Andrew Griffith as new shadow chancellor
stories.summary: Kemi Badenoch has reshuffled her shadow cabinet, bringing in Andrew Griffith as shadow chancellor. His first move was to warn Labour against further tax rises in the autumn budget.

stories.title: Badenoch instructs lawyers to challenge 94% Wandsworth council tax hike
stories.summary: The Conservative leader told BBC Newsnight she is taking legal action over the proposed 94% council tax rise in Tory-run Wandsworth, calling it 'outrageous' while blaming government funding cuts.

stories.title: Analysis: Burnham 'fighting a losing battle against global forces' on the economy
stories.summary: Guardian commentary argues that despite better vibes, PM Burnham faces the same structural economic headwinds — wars, energy prices, borrowing costs — that hampered the Starmer government.

stories.title: Lib Dems launch EU single market campaign to reignite political fortunes
stories.summary: The Liberal Democrats are running a new campaign backing UK re-entry to the EU single market, hoping the issue will boost their poll ratings and differentiate them from Labour.

stories.title: Ed Davey hosts VIP lobbying reception for party stakeholders
stories.summary: Politico reports the Lib Dems ran a VIP reception with leader Ed Davey as part of the party's autumn political influence and fundraising push.

stories.title: Jenrick brands Burnham 'Starmer with a TikTok account' over No 10 document leak
stories.summary: Reform UK's Treasury spokesperson Robert Jenrick responded to the No 10 leak by accusing Burnham of being a continuation of Starmer and warning about sensitive documents being exposed.

stories.title: Reform officials 'plotted to break law on foreign donations' in undercover film
stories.summary: An undercover investigation documented Reform UK officials apparently discussing ways to circumvent legal restrictions on foreign political donations — a major ongoing scandal for the party.

stories.title: Reform UK's record-setting donations raise questions about party funding transparency
stories.summary: Guardian analysis examines what Reform's unprecedented fundraising — including from crypto billionaires — means for UK political finance rules amid growing scrutiny.

stories.title: Swinney vows to deliver independence referendum before 2031
stories.summary: Scottish First Minister John Swinney reaffirmed his commitment to holding a second independence referendum before the end of the current Scottish Parliament following a meeting with devolved nation leaders.

stories.title: Baillie challenges Swinney over Salmond files court case
stories.summary: Labour MSP Jackie Baillie confronted First Minister Swinney over the SNP's legal battle to withhold Salmond inquiry evidence, accusing the party of seeking inappropriate powers.

stories.title: Scotland receives £1.8m from UK's £30m community energy fund
stories.summary: Scotland's share of the new UK community energy investment programme has been confirmed at £1.8 million, amid ongoing SNP pressure to scrap the energy profits levy.

stories.title: Lords debate education and skills reform statement
stories.summary: The House of Lords heard the government's education and skills reform statement from Baroness Smith of Malvern, debating apprenticeships and training policy.

stories.title: Lords debate VAT impact on independent schools amid government reforms
stories.summary: Peers debated the government's decision to apply VAT to independent school fees, with significant opposition from crossbenchers and Conservative peers about impact on smaller schools.

stories.title: House of Lords to debate political donations law changes
stories.summary: The Lords is scheduled to debate the Burnham government's proposed changes to political donation rules, including the controversial bill allowing donations from British expats abroad.
